slides.texte_overlay:
fun hobbies that quietly
build iron discipline

keeping a run log

run three times a week and write each run in a notebook. watching your times slowly improve becomes addictive, and it keeps you showing up every week.

one song a month

learn one complete song on an instrument every month. the first time you play it without a mistake gives you a rush that makes practising feel worth it.

a balcony garden

grow herbs or vegetables from seed. watering them every day and waiting for results quietly teaches your brain that slow, patient effort really pays off.

a learning streak

5 minutes of learning every day, protected like a streak, builds discipline that slowly spreads into every other part of your life, from work to sleep to fitness.
slides.texte_sophia:
a learning streak

protect a daily learning streak. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, a myth or a planet, and keeping that tiny chain made me disciplined in everything.

slides.texte_overlay:
cold morning walks

walk for twenty minutes every morning before breakfast, even in winter. doing something hard first thing makes every other task of the day feel easier.
